claims.claim_text: The indexed Barron B. Boe is a high-confidence match to the World War II U.S. Army captain buried at Riverside National Cemetery.
claims.evidence_excerpt: BOE, BARRON B ... US ARMY, CAPT, WORLD WAR II
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The cemetery transcription independently gives the uncommon exact full name, U.S. Army branch, captain rank, and World War II service shown or implied by the OSS index context.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from uncommon exact full name plus matching Army branch, captain rank, and wartime era; the evidence is a third-party transcription rather than the personnel file.
claims.temporal_assessment: The source confirms World War II military service but supplies no Army-to-OSS sequence or pre-service occupation.
claims.match_notes: This corroborates identity and rank only. No employer, unit, hometown, or OSS assignment is inferred, and the private index identifier remains withheld.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index and official Army merged file share the exact full name Harold R. Bodine and the exact private identifier. The Army file dates entry to June 3, 1943 and records civilian occupation code 180; no accessible source establishes the later Army-to-OSS sequence or an employer.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 64 for Army assignments, OSS-entry chronology, and the employer associated with the Army occupation code.
